reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code on the sachet that opens the batch lab report, and the "no magnesium oxide" line. A dollar a day with free shipping is fine to try once, and the sachets fit in my bag when I sleep at my partner's place.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I have bought magnesium before and felt nothing, so I will not reorder unless I notice something in the first couple of weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings the box under $25, or a smaller trial pack, so I am not committing $30 before I know it works for me.
